title: Evaluation of the Potential CYP1A2-mediated Drug Drug Interaction Safety, and Tolerability of ABX464

primary_outcomes.measure: Part A Evaluate the potential for inhibition and/or induction of CYP1A2 in vivo based on the Peak Plasma Concentration (Cmax) of caffeine (a known CYP1A2 substrate) in the presence and absence of ABX464.

Part A Evaluate the potential for inhibition and/or induction of CYP1A2 in vivo based on the Area under the plasma concentration versus time curve (AUC) of caffeine (a known CYP1A2 substrate) in the presence and absence of ABX464.
Part B Evaluate whether ABX464 is a substrate for CYP1A2 in vivo based on Peak Plasma Concentration (Cmax) in the presence and absence of fluvoxamine.
Part B Evaluate whether ABX464 is a substrate for CYP1A2 in vivo based on Area under the plasma concentration versus time curve (AUC) in the presence and absence of fluvoxamine.
